`standard.cordis.yml` is the unmodified `presets/standard/agent.cordis.yml`
from the locally installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets@0.1.5-rc.2`
(MIT, deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It contains 28 non-group plugin entries.
It reproduces the native Web inventory that motivated the Studio inventory view.
Tests parse it as data; they do not execute its JavaScript expressions or plugins.
